originality.rationale: The determinant/rooted-forest interpretation is prior work. Actual published-finding corpus queries for root-weighted corona optimization, exact spectral root, and clique budget returned no equivalent published finding. Inspected primary literature covers determinant identities, corona Laplacian spectra/coherence, edge-based weighted-tree design, and smallest-eigenvalue pinning, not the unrestricted vertex-transitive corona determinant gain allocation, sharp budget root, and extremal monotonicity. Novelty remains conditional on imperfect indexing/access.
residual_risks: Indexing cannot exclude an unindexed or differently named weighted-root or D-optimal graph theorem that dominates the current classification.
The general log-det KKT mechanism is standard; originality is claimed only for the exact spectral phase threshold and graph-comparison classification.

value.rationale: A natural resource-allocation problem on a broad graph family is solved for all positive budgets and every connected vertex-transitive core, not an arbitrary finite slice. The sharp spectral transition, optimal-support classification, strict edge-addition monotonicity and unique extremal clique threshold give graph-structural information useful for forest-design and grounding; a 4-cycle exact radical threshold differs from the clique.
